^123456Special note:^000000

such as a wolf or hawk,
cannot complete the quest.

身上還帶有狼或鷹之類食肉動物氣味的人，無法完成此任務。

scripts.text: - There are no more requests. -

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Welcome~ Customer~!</FONT>
This is a woodworking shop for firewood~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 14>歡迎光臨~客人~！</FONT>
這裡是柴薪木工店~

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Is there anything~ you're looking for~?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
有什麼~想找的~嗎？

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

Is there anything~ you're looking for~?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
有什麼~想找的~嗎？

scripts.text: About the request.
scripts.translation: 關於委託

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Are you talking about a request~ customer~?
Could you wait a moment, please~?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
客人，您是來接委託的~？
請稍等一下~

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
The carpentry request...
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[木工]
木工的委託...
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I'm sorry, but it's confirmed that there's no request from our woodwork.
May I know what kind of request you've received? Customer~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
不好意思，確認過了，我們店沒有釋出委託。
客人，能說說您接到的是什麼委託嗎~？

scripts.text: Request for firewood.
scripts.translation: 柴薪委託

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Aaah!!!
I'm sorry!
I don't think it's from the woodworking shop, but it's a personal request from the owner~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
啊！！！不好意思！
那不是店裡的委託，是老闆以個人名義發的~

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 10>If the boss asked you to do it, you should've told me!</FONT>
May I have a moment, please? Customer?
I'll call the boss...
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 10>老闆自己發的，也該跟我說一聲啊！</FONT>
客人，您稍等，我去叫老闆...

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 14>This gentleman is out and gone again!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 10>Did he go to the forest again!</FONT>
This can't be happening!!!
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 14>這位老爺又跑沒影了！！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 10>不會又去森林了吧！</FONT>
真拿他沒辦法！！！

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I'm sorry~ Customer.
The boss is out of the office right now.
scripts.translation:
[木工]
不好意思~客人，老闆現在不在。

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I don't know when he'll be back.
If you're in a hurry, why don't you go to ^dd5555Payon Forest^000000?
You go <NAVI>[there]<INFO>pay_fild08,157,129,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[木工]
我不知道他什麼時候回來。
如果您很著急，不妨去^dd5555斐揚樹林^000000看看？
就在<NAVI>[那裡]<INFO>pay_fild08,157,129,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I'm sorry~ Customer.
The boss is out of the office right now.
scripts.translation:
[木工]
不好意思~客人，老闆現在不在。

I don't know when he'll be back.

You go <NAVI>[there]<INFO>pay_fild08,157,129,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

就在<NAVI>[那裡]<INFO>pay_fild08,157,129,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Welcome~ Customer~!</FONT>
This is a woodworking shop for firewood~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 14>歡迎光臨~客人~！</FONT>
這裡是柴薪木工店~

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Do you have any other business?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
您還有別的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Aaaah~~
I'm completely blown away today! I messed up!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
啊啊~~
今天真是完蛋了！全搞砸了！！！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Aaaah~~
I'm completely blown away today! I messed up!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
啊啊~~
今天真是完蛋了！全搞砸了！！！

scripts.text: Chief?
scripts.translation: 老闆？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Who?
...
Did Lee Daegam send you?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
誰？
...
是李大監派你來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
How long has it been since you roasted it? Are you sending someone here again?!
Just pushing doesn't mean it's going to work!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
才催過我多久啊？又派人來了？！
光催也沒用啊！

scripts.text: I came for the request.
scripts.translation: 我是看到委託來的

scripts.text: [Carpenter Firewood] Huh... Huh... Ah!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [木匠 柴薪] 咦... 咦... 啊！！！！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Eheh~~!!
Aaaah!!!
<FONT SIZE = 16>That's right!!!!!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
哎嘿~~！！啊啊啊！！！
<FONT SIZE = 16>對哦，想起來了！！！！！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Sorry!</FONT>
I came out for a while because I didn't have any progress on my work and I was so frustrated, but I didn't expect a customer to visit me.
What a shame!
Eheheh!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>不好意思！</FONT>
活兒一直沒進展，悶得慌，才出來透透氣，沒想到會有客人來找。
真丟人，嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It's the perfect timing!
Now that you've come all the way here, don't go back to the woodwork, come here and look at what the nasty beasts have done.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
來得正好！
既然都來到這裡了，就別回木工店了，過來看看那些可惡的野獸乾的好事。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It looks like they're hoofed guys like deer and wild boars, but...
Why are they so fierce when they're grazing in the woods!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
看起來像是鹿或野豬之類的有蹄動物，可是...
在樹林裡吃草的傢伙們怎麼會這麼兇啊！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It's the perfect timing!
Now that you've come all the way here, don't go back to the woodwork, come here and look at what the nasty beasts have done.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
來得正好！
既然都來到這裡了，就別回木工店了，過來看看那些可惡的野獸乾的好事。

[Carpenter Firewood]
It looks like they're hoofed guys like deer and wild boars, but...
Why are they so fierce when they're grazing in the woods!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]

在樹林裡吃草的傢伙們怎麼會這麼兇啊！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
So, how is your investigation going?
Have you found those wild animals yet?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那麼，調查進展得怎麼樣了？
找到那些野生動物了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
What have you found, adventurer?
What have you got?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
冒險者，你發現了什麼？
有什麼收穫嗎？

scripts.text: About the food that fell on the street.
scripts.translation: 關於掉在街上的食物

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
How could someone throw food on the street? Food is precious, it's such a waste!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
怎麼會有人把食物扔在路上？食物很珍貴的，太浪費了！！

scripts.text: About wild animals.
scripts.translation: 關於野生動物

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I'm glad it fed some wild animals, but...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
能餵飽一些野生動物倒是好事，可是...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then didn't the wild animals come all the way here while picking up the food?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那麼，那些野生動物是不是一路撿著食物走到這裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Who could have done such a strange thing...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
到底是誰幹了這麼奇怪的事...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Anyway, the adventurer took over the job, so I can see some clues!
With this momentum, we'll solve this before Lee Daegam goes crazy again...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
總之，多虧你接下委託，總算有點頭緒了！
趁著勢頭，趕緊解決，免得李大監又來發脾氣...

scripts.text:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Ahem!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Do you have a factory~</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>咳咳！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>工廠裡有人嗎~</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Ugh....
Eddga told me he was coming...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
唉...真是說曹操，曹操就到...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Lee Daegam, what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
李大監，您怎麼來了？

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh~~ Eheh~ It's nothing special~
I'm here to see if everything is going well~
scripts.translation:
[李大監]
哦~~ 嘿嘿~ 沒什麼特別的事~
我就是來看看事情進展得順不順利~

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It won't work if you come all the time like this...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
您這樣老是跑過來，事情可辦不成啊...

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh my~
It doesn't look much different from yesterday.
You didn't even start working on it, but I hear loud noises~
scripts.translation:
[李大監]
哎呀~
看起來和昨天沒什麼兩樣嘛。
明明還沒開始動工，卻聽到很大的動靜~

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh... I... I...!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I can't work because the tools keep breaking down!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>If you're here to tease me, you're just disturbing me, so go back!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>啊...我...我...！！！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>工具老是壞，我根本沒法幹活！！！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>如果您是來取笑我的，那隻會妨礙我，請回吧！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh my!
You don't have to yell that much. I'm going!
<FONT SIZE = 18>Hmph!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[李大監]
哎呀！
用不著吼這麼大聲。我走就是了！
<FONT SIZE = 18>哼！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh, that old man!</FONT>
Are you asking me to work or not? You're just increasing my temper again!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>那個老頭！</FONT>
到底要不要我幹活啊？就會讓我更火大！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
He's only disturbing me, let alone helping me with what I've entrusted with you.
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh my!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
你這邊還在調查，他不幫忙就算了，還跑來添亂。
<FONT SIZE = 14>真是的！</FONT>

scripts.text: About Lee Daegam.
scripts.translation: 關於李大監

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
As you've heard before, he is a great leader, ^123456Lee Daegam^000000, who left this job to me.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
你剛才也聽到了，他就是把工程交給我的那位大人，^123456李大監^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I'll be making a vacation spot for young people around here! What do you say!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
說是要在這附近給年輕人建個度假勝地！你說說！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I told you that construction would be difficult because it was an area full of monsters, but who knew that even wild animals would be such a problem?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
我跟他說過，這一帶魔物很多，施工會很困難，可誰能想到連野生動物都這麼麻煩？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
In the meantime, he came to me a today and teased me like that...
If you can't solve this problem again, I think I should quit...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
今天還跑來這麼挖苦我...
這回的麻煩要是解決不了，我真想撂挑子了...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then I'll be organizing my luggage in the cart.
Take a closer look at ^dd5555Broken Tools^000000.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那我去整理手推車上的行李。
你仔細看看^dd5555損壞的工具^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
In the meantime, he came to me a today and teased me like that...
If you can't solve this problem again, I think I should quit...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
今天還跑來這麼挖苦我...
這回的麻煩要是解決不了，我真想撂挑子了...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then I'll be organizing my luggage in the cart.
Take a closer look at ^dd5555Broken Tools^000000.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那我去整理手推車上的行李。
你仔細看看^dd5555損壞的工具^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Oh my... Oh my...
How in the world could that happen...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
天哪...天哪...
怎麼會發生這種事...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
He was a grumpy gentleman, but he wasn't that bad of a person, so what happened...
Oh my...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
他雖然脾氣古怪，但也不是什麼壞人，到底發生了什麼...
天哪...

scripts.text: - It contains broken tools. -
scripts.translation: - 裡面裝著損壞的工具。-

scripts.text: - Around the box, animal footprints are imprinted in disorder, and as the Carpenter Firewood said, they appear to be herbivorous footprints. -
scripts.translation: - 工具箱旁雜亂地印著許多動物腳印，看起來正如木匠柴薪所說，是食草動物留下的。-

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
What do you say, adventurer?
You think you know something?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
冒險者，你怎麼看？
有什麼頭緒了嗎？

scripts.text: I think I need to look around a little more.
scripts.translation: 我覺得還要再四處看看

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then look around carefully.
We have to start construction as soon as possible, so don't take too long.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那就仔細找找吧。
我們得儘快開工，所以別拖太久。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Let me know if you find out anything while you take a look.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
看的時候要是發現了什麼，就告訴我。

scripts.translation: - 裡面裝著損壞的工具。-

scripts.text: - Around the box, animal footprints are imprinted in disorder, and as the Carpenter Firewood said, they appear to be herbivorous footprints. -

scripts.text: - A closer look at the broken tools shows a blurry stain. -
scripts.translation: - 仔細檢視損壞的工具，發現上面有一塊模糊的汙漬。-

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Oh no!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>You can't eat that!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 16>糟糕！！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>那個不能吃！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>It smells delicious, but it makes you sick.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>雖然聞起來很香，但吃了會生病的。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>The things I ate in the forest were sweet and delicious, but the snake strawberries I picked up earlier were bitter!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>I'm angry!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 18>My stomach hurts!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我在森林裡吃的東西又甜又好吃，但我剛才摘的蛇莓卻是苦的！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>氣死我了！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 18>肚子好痛！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Even the friends who followed the food here went home angry!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]

Lee Daegam.

李大監。

scripts.translation: - 可以看到可疑的波紋。-

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh no!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>What's this hideous atmosphere!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>As expected, Hyunrok seems to have noticed!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>糟糕！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>這氣氛怎麼這麼詭異！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>果然，玄鹿好像察覺到了！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>What if we're in big trouble?</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Let's hurry up, go in and stop Hyunrok.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>要是惹上大麻煩怎麼辦？</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>快進去阻止玄鹿吧。</FONT>

scripts.text: - A suspicious ripple appears where Chulho disappeared. -
scripts.translation: - 哲浩消失的地方出現了可疑的波紋。-

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: ^ff0000An unknown error occurred.^000000

- The swaying looks unsettling.
Let's wait a bit and then go in. -
scripts.translation:
- 波紋晃動得令人不安。
稍等一會兒再進去吧。-

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 請等一下！！-
- 您的物品太多了，無法再領取任何物品。-
- 請騰出一些空間後再試一次。-

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
Please use all your skill points before proceeding.
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
繼續之前，請先用完所有技能點。

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>I've been waiting!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>It's hard to come to the Deep Forest now, but come to think of it, I just have to come out to play!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Although Hyunrok won't come out!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我等你好久了！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>現在要去森林深處很難，不過轉念一想，我出來玩就好了嘛！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>雖然玄鹿不會出來！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh, and this is a letter from Hyunrok!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Go ahead and read it!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>哦，還有，這是玄鹿的信！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>快讀讀看吧！</FONT>

scripts.text: Read the letter.
scripts.translation: 閱讀信件

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
Dear {0}.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
親愛的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
It's a relationship just by touching your clothes...
The reason you entered this forest and the reason we met must be all fate that the heavens decided.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
萍水相逢，亦是緣分...
你踏入這片森林，我們得以相遇，想來都是上天註定。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
I will never forget the grace that helped us in danger even though we did not see the relationship properly and were disrespectful in the immediate event.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
先前因一時之事，未能看清這份緣分，對你多有失禮。
危難之際，你仍出手相助，此恩我永誌不忘。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
As Chulho said, I wanted to at least hold a feast to repay you, but staying in this Deep Forest for a long time is dangerous to those outside the forest, so I feel heavy to send them back in a hurry without even telling them a proper goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
正如哲浩所言，本想設宴相謝，奈何外來者不宜久留密林。
未及好好道別，便匆匆送你離去，心中實在歉然。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
I'm sure you'll understand because I did it for you.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
我是為你著想才這麼做的，相信你會理解。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
And it's not a small reward for your help, but it's engraved in our souls so that we can call out our strength whenever we need help.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
為報答你的幫助，我們已將這份約定銘刻於靈魂。
日後若有需要，儘可呼喚我們的力量。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
Then, let's look forward to seeing each other again...
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
盼他日重逢...

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Have you finished reading the letter?</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>What did it say?</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>你讀完那封信了嗎？</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>上面寫了什麼？</FONT>

scripts.text: Show the letter.
scripts.translation: 出示信件

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hyunrok always says things that are hard to understand!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>And take this, too!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I saved it because it was a fun item, but I'll give it to you!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>玄鹿總是說些很難懂的話！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>這個也拿去吧！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>我本來覺得這東西好玩才留著，不過就送給你吧！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>See you again</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I was just out playing.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>下次見啦！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>我還會出來玩的。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>There's so much fun outside the forest!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Of course the forest is fun too!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>森林外面有好多好玩的事情！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>當然，森林裡也很好玩！</FONT>
